text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: You, O mortal, thus says the Lord God to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
text_cn: “人子，你要说：吾主上主这样对以色列地域说：结局到了，大地四极的结局到了。”

text_en: Now the end is upon you, I will let loose my anger upon you; I will judge you according to your ways, I will punish you for all your abominations.
text_cn: 现今你的结局已到：我要向你发泄我的愤怒，按你的行为裁判你，按照你所有的丑行报复你。

text_en: My eye will not spare you, I will have no pity. I will punish you for your ways, while your abominations are among you. Then you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 我的眼决不怜视你，一点也不顾惜你；反之，我必按照你的行为报复你，使你的丑恶彰显在你中间；这样，你们必承认我是上主。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : Disaster after disaster! See, it comes.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“看，灾祸，那唯一的灾祸来了。

text_en: An end has come, the end has come. It has awakened against you; see, it comes!
text_cn: 结局到了，那对付你的结局到了，看，已来到目前。

text_en: Your doom has come to you, O inhabitant of the land. The time has come, the day is near— of tumult, not of reveling on the mountains.
text_cn: 当地的居民啊！恶运已临于你，时辰已到，恐怖的日子已近，山上再听不到欢呼的声音。

text_en: Soon now I will pour out my wrath upon you; I will spend my anger against you. I will judge you according to your ways, and punish you for all your abominations.
text_cn: 现今我就快要向你发泄我的愤怒，在你身上尽泄我的怒火，要按照你的行为裁判你，按照你所有的丑行报复你。

text_en: My eye will not spare; I will have no pity. I will punish you according to your ways, while your abominations are among you. Then you shall know that it is I the Lord who strike.
text_cn: 我的眼决不怜视，一点也不顾惜；反之，我要照你的行为报复你，使你的丑恶彰显在你中间：这样，你们必承认我是施罚的天主。”

text_en: See, the day! See, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed, pride has budded.
text_cn: “看，那日子确已来到，恶运已定，暴行开花，傲慢发芽。

text_en: Violence has grown into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain, not their abundance, not their wealth; no pre-eminence among them.
text_cn: 残暴兴起，成为作恶的权杖；他们中将一无所存，他们的财富没有了，豪华不见了，光荣一无所留。

text_en: The time has come, the day draws near; let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn, for wrath is upon all their multitude.
text_cn: 时辰到了，日子近了；买主不要欢乐；卖主也不要忧愁，因为怒火要降在一切财富上。

text_en: For the sellers shall not return to what has been sold as long as they remain alive. For the vision concerns all their multitude; it shall not be revoked. Because of their iniquity, they cannot maintain their lives.
text_cn: 卖主虽还活着，但不得再赎回他所卖的，因为惩罚一降在一切民众身上，谁也不能再挽回。无人在罪恶中能保全生命。

text_en: They have blown the horn and made everything ready; but no one goes to battle, for my wrath is upon all their multitude.
text_cn: 你们吹喇叭，将一切准备便当；但无人出征上阵，因为我的怒火要降在所有人民身上。

text_en: The sword is outside, pestilence and famine are inside; those in the field die by the sword; those in the city—famine and pestilence devour them.
text_cn: 外有刀兵，内有瘟疫饥荒；凡在乡间的，要丧身刀下；在城中的，要死于瘟疫饥荒。

text_en: If any survivors escape, they shall be found on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning over their iniquity.
text_cn: 那些侥幸逃亡的，到了山中，必像谷中哀鸣的鸽子，各人悲泣自己的罪恶。

text_en: All hands shall grow feeble, all knees turn to water.
text_cn: 人人双手疲惫无力，双膝软弱如水，

text_en: They shall put on sackcloth, horror shall cover them. Shame shall be on all faces, baldness on all their heads.
text_cn: 身穿苦衣，都为恐怖所笼罩；每人面带羞惭，头顶完全剃光。

text_en: They shall fling their silver into the streets, their gold shall be treated as unclean. Their silver and gold cannot save them on the day of the wrath of the Lord . They shall not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it. For it was the stumbling block of their iniquity.
text_cn: 他们将自己的银子丢在街头，金子为他们成了污秽之物；他们的金银，在上主发怒之日，不能拯救他们；金银不能使他们充饥，不能填满他们的肚腹，因为金银是他们犯罪的绊脚石。

text_en: From their beautiful ornament, in which they took pride, they made their abominable images, their detestable things; therefore I will make of it an unclean thing to them.
text_cn: 他们既然把自己华丽的装饰品作为夸耀的东西，做成丑恶的偶像和怪物；

text_en: I will hand it over to strangers as booty, to the wicked of the earth as plunder; they shall profane it.
text_cn: 所以我要使偶像成为他们的不洁之物，我要把它交于外邦人手中作胜利品，给本地匪徒作为掠物，而予以亵渎。

text_en: I will avert my face from them, so that they may profane my treasured place; the violent shall enter it, they shall profane it.
text_cn: 我要转面不看他们，让外人亵渎我的宝藏，让野人侵入而加以亵渎，

text_en: Make a chain! For the land is full of bloody crimes; the city is full of violence.
text_cn: 并用来制造锁链；因为此地充满了血债，城中充满了残暴。

text_en: I will bring the worst of the nations to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the arrogance of the strong, and their holy places shall be profaned.
text_cn: 为此，我必叫最凶恶的异民来占据他们的房舍，消灭他们傲慢的势力，并使他们的圣所受到亵渎。

text_en: When anguish comes, they will seek peace, but there shall be none.
text_cn: 当恐怖来临时，他们寻求救援，却没有救援。

text_en: Disaster comes upon disaster, rumor follows rumor; they shall keep seeking a vision from the prophet; instruction shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
text_cn: 祸上加祸，噩耗接踵而来；那时人向先知要求异像，却毫无所得；司祭失去了教言，长老没有了主意，

text_en: The king shall mourn, the prince shall be wrapped in despair, and the hands of the people of the land shall tremble. According to their way I will deal with them; according to their own judgments I will judge them. And they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 君王失声痛哭，王侯惊惶失措，当地居民的手颤动无力。我必按他们的行为向他们报复，照他们的功过裁判他们：这样，他们必要承认我是天主。”
